Before You Begin · Step 1 of 2

First, install TestFlight

TestFlight is Apple's free app for installing beta apps. You need it before you can download College Dance Prep.

1
Scan the QR code with your iPhone camera — it opens the TestFlight page in the App Store
2
Tap "Get" to download and install TestFlight — it's free
3
If prompted, tap "Allow Notifications" — TestFlight uses notifications to alert you to app updates
4
Once TestFlight is installed, go to the next slide to download the College Dance Prep app
Already have TestFlight? Skip ahead to the next slide.

Before You Begin · Step 2 of 2

Then, download the PrepMaster app

With TestFlight installed, scan the QR code to join the College Dance Prep beta and install the app.

2
Tap "Accept" to join the beta, then "Install"
3
When the app opens, tap "Allow Notifications" — this is how you'll receive session reminders and booking alerts
4
Sign in with the credentials you'll create on the next slides

Step 1 · Getting Started

You'll receive an invite email

When an admin adds you as a PrepMaster, you get an email with a personal invite link tied to your address.

1
Check your inbox for an email from College Dance Prep — check spam if not found
2
Click "Set up my account" in the email
3
You land on a pre-filled sign-up page — no code or account number needed
Tip: The link stays valid until your invite is revoked by an admin.
from: noreply@collegedanceprep.com
You've been invited as a PrepMaster

Hi Sarah,

You've been invited to join College Dance Prep as a PrepMaster. Click below to set up your account.

Step 3 · The Portal

Your PrepMaster portal at a glance

After signing in on the iOS app, four tabs give you access to everything.

Dashboard
All your bookings in list or calendar view. Tap a session to expand, cancel, or edit.
Availability
Schedule new sessions and set your weekly open hours so clients can book you.
Inbox
All activity — new requests, cancellations, reschedules — with an unread filter.
Profile
Your info, Google Calendar link, appearance settings, and role switcher.
To get started: Download the College Dance Prep app and sign in with your new credentials.
04

See all your upcoming sessions

The Dashboard opens in List view — a chronological feed of every booked session.

1
List / Calendar toggle — switch between views anytime

Each card shows date, time, client name, session type

Tap the chevron on a card to expand it and reveal actions
4
Previous sessions — past and cancelled bookings below the upcoming list

Dashboard · Session Actions

Expand a session to edit it

Tap the chevron on any booking card to expand an inline edit form — change date, time, and notes without leaving the Dashboard.

Tap ∧ to expand — the card reveals an edit form in-place

YOUR NOTES — visible to the member; add context or instructions

Tap Save changes to apply, or Cancel to discard

Month grid & session detail

Switch to Calendar view for a visual overview. Tap any date with a session to see its details.

Availability · Schedule

Schedule a new session

In the Availability tab, proactively book a session — choose client, date, time, and length.

1
"Schedule for a past client" — expand to pick who you're booking
2
CLIENT — tap a pill to select that client
3
DATE strip — tap any day in the 7-day window
4
TIME drum — scroll to set the start time; selected time highlights
5
SESSION LENGTH — 30 / 45 / 60 / 90 min with credit cost shown

Tap Confirm booking to create the confirmed session immediately

Availability · Weekly Hours

Set your weekly availability

The Edit Booking Availability section defines which days and hours you're open. Clients can only request sessions within these windows.

1
Each day has a pink toggle — switch off to block all bookings that day
2
Set a FROM and TO time for each enabled day
3
Scroll down to configure each day of the week — all seven are shown
Example: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM Mon–Fri, closed on weekends.

Inbox · Notifications

Stay on top of every update

The Inbox tab collects all activity — new requests, cancellations, and reschedules — with full context in each notification.

1
Unread / All filter — Unread shows only unseen notifications
2
New session request — a client wants to book at a specific date & time
3
Session cancelled — shows whether it was within the 24-hour payable window
4
Session rescheduled — client moved their booking; check the updated time
Tip: Enable push notifications in iPhone Settings → College Dance Prep so you're alerted the moment a request comes in.

Profile · Settings

Profile, connections & appearance

The Profile tab is your control center — update your info, link your Google account, sync Google Calendar, and set your theme.

1
MY INFO — add your phone, university, and address
2
CONNECTED ACCOUNTS — link Google for one-tap sign-in and sync Google Calendar
3
LINK GOOGLE — tap the banner or the Google row; your Gmail must match your CDP email
4
APPEARANCE — choose Light, Dark, or System theme
Admin accounts only: A Switch View option appears in your Profile tab — use it to jump between Admin view, PrepMaster view, and Member view without signing out.

Profile · Google Account

Link Google for faster sign-in

After signing in, you can connect your Google account so you never need to type a password again — just tap "Continue with Google" on the login screen.

1
Open the Profile tab in the app
2
Tap "Link Google" in the banner or the connected accounts section
3
Sign in with the Google account that matches your CDP email — mismatched emails are rejected for security
4
Done — future logins can use Google One Tap, no password needed
Important: Your Google account email must exactly match the email on your CDP account. This is enforced to keep your account secure.

Quick reference

Invite & Sign-up
Email link → set password → instant access, no approval wait.
Dashboard List
Tap the chevron on any session to expand and edit it inline.
Calendar View
Month grid with highlighted session days. Tap a date to see that day's bookings.
New Session
Availability → past client → date, time, length → Confirm booking.
Availability Hours
Toggle days on/off, set FROM–TO times so clients book within your schedule.
Inbox & Profile
Inbox for all alerts. Profile for info, Google sign-in link, Google Calendar, and theme.
Questions? Your admin can resend your invite or adjust your settings from the admin panel.
